_note: Written by team/E1/propulsion.py (do not hand-edit). Instance nodes per station (UR UL LR LL). Motor-to-mount (E-FIN-61..64) and ESC-to-pad (E-FIN-65..68) edges are D3's; every electrical edge (ESC power, phase, signal) is harness's (D-20) and is acknowledged when harness publishes it.

parts.name: Motor UR SunnySky X3108S KV900 (CW from the nose)
parts.notes: 81.0 g with factory leads + 4 x M3x8 screws 3.2 g (PRP-005); CG 45 % of the 26.5 mm body ahead of the mount face (EST); axis canted 7 deg tangentially (params cant_deg), not drawn in the CG

parts.name: ESC UR LANRC 45 A
parts.notes: 11.0 g EST with leads and heat-shrink; on the outboard face of FIN-007, heat-sink side out in the slipstream

parts.name: Prop UR APC 11x5.5MRP (LP11055MRP)
parts.notes: hub centre on the prop plane x -0.0082 m (params, D-28); E1's stack puts it 1.7 mm further aft until measured

parts.name: Prop adapter UR M6x1 LH + nut + washer
parts.notes: LH thread: prop drag tightens the nut on a CW motor (CR-E1-21)

connection_types.spec: bolt-on prop adapter, 4 x M3x4 SHCS into the motor bell, pilot on the shaft
M6x1 nut and washer clamp the prop hub on the adapter post (field joint)

edges.notes: adapter pilot on the 4 mm shaft, four screws into the bell top on a 12 mm circle (vendor fit list names the X3108S KV900)

joint_stack.hole: counterbored clearance in the adapter base; tapped M3 in the bell
joint_stack.access: from the front (-x) with the prop off

retention.load_n: prop torque 0.33 N m at full throttle on a 6 mm radius = 14 N per screw in shear; thrust 16 N / 4 = 4 N axial
retention.inspection: witness mark on each head, checked at every field set-up

edges.notes: 11x5.5MRP (LP11055MRP) on a LH post; LPAR06E ring centres the 1/4 in bore on the M6 post; prop off for transport

joint_stack.fastener: M6x1 hex nut ISO 4032 (LH) + M6 washer ISO 7089
joint_stack.hole: 6.35 mm prop bore with LPAR06E ring to 6 mm
joint_stack.torque: 1.5 N m EST (nylon hub; snug, no crushing)
